services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Updated April 16, 2026: The lake opened up about two weeks ago by a gale force wind, sinking the last few sheets of ice on the very north end. My first opportunity came April 8th. I picked my best weather to fish as it has been very windy. Decided to fish shallow right away and it paid off. Some of the better ones I boated over the last four trips, chunky largemouth, big pickerel and a colorful rudd. Updated March 17, 2026: Lake Champlain is mostly ice covered, but lake levels are rising and areas still iced over are seeing ice separating from the shoreline. blurb: Guests go fishing on Lake Champlain with Captain Mick Maynard, who is knowledgeable about the lake and fishing spots. The charters focus on catching bass and pike, with opportunities for teaching fishing techniques. Trips can last several hours and accommodate up to three guests.
extraNote: Book two or three days in a row recommended due to weather variability
